# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Referenced only inside the `ImageViewer` component; not mounted as a global overlay.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the only trigger, dispatched exclusively by clicking thumbnails.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules.

## Bug 6373 Investigation (preview-close)
- Worktree created on submodule branch `fix/bug-6373-preview-close`; `node_modules` not linked yet as of 2026-11-09.
- Hypothesis A: `dialogVisible` setter calls `handleClose()` → `closePreview`; if `handleClose` throws (e.g. `stopDrag`/`stopResize`), setter fails and `showViewer` stays `true`, so dialog never closes. RULED OUT: `stopDrag`/`stopResize` are safe, `handleClose` does not throw.
- Hypothesis B: drag directive swallows the X close click. RULED OUT: `zs-dialog` uses the same `v-dialogDrag` directive and closes fine; drag math causes no X displacement.
- Close path provably correct down to `el-dialog` internals; remaining unknown is how the dev-company basic-info page actually triggers the preview.
- Next step: find the dev-company basic-info page and all `preview` call sites to trace the real trigger.

# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Globally mounted as `<image-viewer />` overlay; the dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the trigger, dispatched by `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` and drivable via `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` in Playwright.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules; Vue is injected via a build-time `<%- injectVue %>` placeholder that loads a global `vue.js`/`vue.min.js`, and `element-ui.js` is a global `defer` script expecting global `Vue`.
- `main.js` exposes `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` and `window.__VUE_APP_ROUTER__` globally, enabling Playwright to drive the real `ImageViewer` without login.

## Bug Hypotheses
- Hypothesis A: `dialogVisible` setter calls `handleClose()` → `closePreview`; if `handleClose` throws (e.g. `stopDrag`/`stopResize`), setter fails and `showViewer` stays `true`, so dialog never closes. RULED OUT: `stopDrag`/`stopResize` are safe, `handleClose` does not throw.
- Hypothesis B: drag directive swallows the X close click. RULED OUT: `zs-dialog` uses the same `v-dialogDrag` directive and closes fine; drag math causes no X displacement.

## Bug 6373 Status
- Worktree created on submodule branch `fix/bug-6373-preview-close`; `node_modules` junctions placed to parent root (npm workspaces hoists deps there), so build resolves from parent root as of 2026-11-09.
- Close path provably correct down to `el-dialog` internals; dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`, and `<image-viewer />` is globally mounted.
- Empirical confirmation (2026-11-09): Playwright repro on the live 8098 nginx buggy build opened preview via `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` and clicked X; after click `showViewer` stays `true` and `.custom-image-viewer` wrapper persists (`wrapperAfter: 1`) with zero console errors — bug reproduced.
- Next step: instrument the repro to capture whether the close-button click fires and whether the drag directive mutates `.el-dialog` to `position:absolute` on the X mousedown, to find the actual close mechanism failure.
